scope.included: Fashion-relevant clothing, footwear, intimates, swimwear, headwear and accessory brands discovered from current U.S. department-store and department-store-adjacent retailer directories.
scope.excluded: Home-only, beauty-only, furniture, cookware and electronics brands unless they also participate in fashion.
scope.note: Retailer assortments change continuously; this is a dated, refreshable discovery snapshot. Brand presence is independent of sizing-chart availability.
